defaultMaxSteps.description: the step ceiling the spawn tool passes when the model omits maxSteps; the run's own ceiling still clamps it

description.description: overrides the tool description the model reads

capabilities: registers one tool (spawn) that runs a child agent through ToolContext.Subagents
the spawn result carries the child's final text; refusals (depth/concurrency/token) surface as teaching error results
annotations: not read-only, destructive-capable, so the call asks
